supinate.definition: v. turn (the hand or forearm) so that the back is downward or backward, or turn out (the leg)
supinate.translation: v. 转动手使掌心向上, 仰转

supinated.definition: v. turn (the hand or forearm) so that the back is downward or backward, or turn out (the leg)
supinated.translation:
vi. 仰转；脚底向上或朝前
vt. 使掌心向上

supinates.definition: v. turn (the hand or forearm) so that the back is downward or backward, or turn out (the leg)

supination.definition: n. rotation of the hands and forearms so that the palms face upward
supination.translation:
n. 旋后, 仰转, 仰卧位
[医] 仰卧, 旋后

supinator.definition: n. a muscle (especially in the forearm) that produces or assists in supination
supinator.translation:
n. 旋后肌
[医] 旋后肌

supine.translation:
a. 仰卧的, 掌心向上的, 懒散的
[医] 仰卧的, 旋后的

supinely.definition:
r with the face upward
r in an indifferently supine manner
supinely.translation: adv. 掌心向上地, 仰卧地
